CustomField.description: Count of Credit Checks on this application currently marked Is_Latest__c. Exists so the grounding confidence calc can see the bureau signal from a before-save flow, which cannot query child records. Recalculates automatically when CreditBureauService inserts a check and flips the previous one, which re-fires the confidence flow and refreshes the band without any extra automation. Normally 0 or 1 — a value above 1 means the Is_Latest__c pointer has been left inconsistent.
CustomField.label: Current Credit Checks
